payload.text: CarryInputs::discount_df() is a pure accessor delegating to self.carry.discount_df(self.t) — no side effects, no mutation. For an FX Carry::FxRates carry this is byte-identical to VanillaInputs::df_dom (the FX two-rate discount), since the underlying Carry::discount_df reads r_dom verbatim. This is the generalized carry-tagged discount used by the cross-asset pricing seam (celnet-core CarryInputs / CarryPricer), proved byte-identical for FX by fx_carry_inputs_byte_identical (ADR-0008).
